seoTitle: Pricing — Simple Plans for AI Chatbots
seoDescription: DialogHive pricing: transparent monthly plans for AI chatbots on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website. Start at $49/month — leads, broadcasts and analytics included.

plans.name: Starter
plans.tagline: For small businesses starting with chat automation
features: AI answers trained on your business data

plans.name: Growth
plans.tagline: For growing businesses on multiple channels
features: All 4 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Website

plans.name: Scale
plans.tagline: For high-volume businesses and multi-location brands

faqs.a: Standard onboarding is included in every plan — we set up your bot, train it on your business data and connect your channels. Complex custom automation flows may carry a one-time setup fee, quoted upfront.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my plan anytime?
faqs.a: Yes. Plans are month-to-month with Stripe billing. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel from your client portal whenever you like — no long-term contracts.
Platform usage is included in your plan. WhatsApp/Meta may charge conversation fees on their side depending on your volume and country; we help you estimate these before launch.
Each place your bot talks to customers: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, and your website widget. The Growth plan includes all four.

faqs.q: Do you offer custom or agency pricing?
faqs.a: Yes — for agencies, franchises and multi-location businesses we build custom packages. Contact us with your requirements and we will prepare a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial or demo?
faqs.a: We offer a free live demo with a bot configured for your industry, so you can see exactly how it will talk to your customers before you pay anything.
